name: Plataleorhynchus
sum: Spoonbill-snouted ctenochasmatid from the Purbeck Group (Tithonian–Berriasian) of Dorset, England.
holotype: NHMUK PV R 11957 — Purbeck Group, Langton Matravers, Dorset.
material: Incomplete front of the upper jaw with teeth.
biology: Circular, spatula-shaped snout with sideways-pointing teeth and a horn-covered palate pad; perhaps stirred up animals from muddy or weedy bottoms.
author: Howse and Milner 1995
